wholePhysicalScope: Native OpenStreetMap way 530642357 constrains the 59 m wide main shrine platform and the short roofed connections. The open courtyard and eastern path establish the facade side and stair direction.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve both curved roofs, broad stone podium and divided stairs. Closer levels refine the lattice, painted brackets, balusters and ridge ends.
limitations: The principal shrine is represented around the 2006 upload date. Exterior section heights, off-camera elevations, stair counts and rail motifs are visual estimates.

The unchanged provider terrain is a composite ground surface. It drops below the raised podium at the rear and north side. The stair feet are approximated against that field. Detached buildings and precinct walls are excluded.
